title: Intake
activation: a long, messy, nonlinear request with several asks
the asks outnumber the sentences stating them
standDown: thinking out loud with no ask yet
outcomes: an execution plan with primary outcome, constraints, decisions made, parking lot
inputs: the request in the person's own words
the project constitution when one exists
minimumEvidence: every load-bearing claim cites what it rests on or is marked unverified
escalation: a genuinely blocking question is asked; everything else proceeds on labeled assumptions
